agent (claude-haiku-5-5): Packaged LibreOffice headless as a stdlib-only converter. convert.py validates the input (extension, readability, 25 MiB limit, zip/XML or RTF header integrity), copies it into a private temp dir with the document title set to its metadata title or the file stem, and converts it with LibreOffice using PDF/A-2b (SelectPdfVersion=2). Each run uses its own LibreOffice profile so concurrent runs work. Exit codes: 0 success, 2 unsupported or unreadable/corrupt input, 3 over 25 MiB, 4 timeout (60 s, overridable via CONVERT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS for tests). Spreadsheets export all sheets through the Calc PDF filter. tests/make_fixtures.py builds minimal docx/odt/rtf/pptx/xlsx files with the standard library, and tests/test_convert.py covers conversion, PDF/A marker, text, title rules, non-ASCII names, exit codes and concurrency, writing only to pytest tmp_path. Caveats: I have not executed this in the sandbox, so the pytest run and the minimal pptx/xlsx fixtures are unverified. ODT or OOXML files without a metadata part get the stem as title rather than a metadata title, because the converter does not add missing metadata parts.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Convert .docx .odt .rtf .pptx .xlsx to PDF/A-2b using LibreOffice headless.
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import zipfile
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+EXIT_OK = 0
+EXIT_ERROR = 1
+EXIT_UNREADABLE = 2
+EXIT_TOO_LARGE = 3
+EXIT_TIMEOUT = 4
+
+MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024
+CONVERSION_TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get('CONVERT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', '60'))
+BS = chr(92)
+DC_NS = 'http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/'
+OFFICE_NS = 'urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0'
+DC = '{%s}' % DC_NS
+OFFICE_META = '{%s}meta' % OFFICE_NS
+PDF_OPTIONS = '{"SelectPdfVersion":{"type":"long","value":"2"}}'
+
+# extension -> (main part checked for validity, LibreOffice PDF filter, metadata part)
+SUPPORTED = {
+    '.docx': ('word/document.xml', 'writer_pdf_Export', 'docProps/core.xml'),
+    '.odt': ('content.xml', 'writer_pdf_Export', 'meta.xml'),
+    '.rtf': (None, 'writer_pdf_Export', None),
+    '.pptx': ('ppt/presentation.xml', 'impress_pdf_Export', 'docProps/core.xml'),
+    '.xlsx': ('xl/workbook.xml', 'calc_pdf_Export', 'docProps/core.xml'),
+}
+
+for _prefix, _uri in [
+    ('dc', DC_NS),
+    ('office', OFFICE_NS),
+    ('cp', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties'),
+    ('dcterms', 'http://purl.org/dc/terms/'),
+    ('xsi', 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'),
+]:
+    ET.register_namespace(_prefix, _uri)
+
+
+def fail(code, message):
+    sys.stderr.write('convert.py: %s\n' % message)
+    sys.exit(code)
+
+
+def group_end(text, start):
+    # index of the closing brace of the RTF group opened at text[start], or -1
+    depth = 0
+    i = start
+    while i < len(text):
+        c = text[i]
+        if c == BS:
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        if c == '{':
+            depth += 1
+        elif c == '}':
+            depth -= 1
+            if depth == 0:
+                return i
+        i += 1
+    return -1
+
+
+def rtf_title(text):
+    marker = '{' + BS + 'title'
+    start = text.find(marker)
+    if start < 0:
+        return None
+    end = group_end(text, start)
+    if end < 0:
+        return None
+    body = text[start + len(marker):end]
+    out = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(body):
+        c = body[i]
+        if c == BS and i + 1 < len(body):
+            nxt = body[i + 1]
+            if nxt in '{}' + BS:
+                out.append(nxt)
+                i += 2
+                continue
+            if nxt == "'" and i + 3 < len(body):
+                out.append(bytes([int(body[i + 2:i + 4], 16)]).decode('cp1252', 'replace'))
+                i += 4
+                continue
+            m = re.match('u(-?[0-9]+)[?]?', body[i + 1:])
+            if m:
+                out.append(chr(int(m.group(1)) % 65536))
+                i += 1 + m.end()
+                continue
+            m = re.match('[a-zA-Z]+(-?[0-9]*) ?', body[i + 1:])
+            if m:
+                i += 1 + m.end()
+                continue
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        if c not in ('{', '}', chr(13), chr(10)):
+            out.append(c)
+        i += 1
+    return ''.join(out).strip() or None
+
+
+def rtf_escape(title):
+    out = []
+    for ch in title:
+        if ch in BS + '{}':
+            out.append(BS + ch)
+        elif ord(ch) < 128:
+            out.append(ch if ch >= ' ' else ' ')
+        else:
+            data = ch.encode('utf-16-be')
+            for k in range(0, len(data), 2):
+                n = int.from_bytes(data[k:k + 2], 'big')
+                if n > 32767:
+                    n -= 65536
+                out.append(BS + 'u%d?' % n)
+    return ''.join(out)
+
+
+def read_title(path, ext):
+    if ext == '.rtf':
+        with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
+            return rtf_title(fh.read().decode('latin-1'))
+    part = SUPPORTED[ext][2]
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
+        if part not in zf.namelist():
+            return None
+        root = ET.fromstring(zf.read(part))
+    for el in root.iter(DC + 'title'):
+        if el.text and el.text.strip():
+            return el.text.strip()
+    return None
+
+
+def patch_core_xml(data, title, is_odf):
+    root = ET.fromstring(data)
+    titles = list(root.iter(DC + 'title'))
+    if titles:
+        for el in titles:
+            el.text = title
+    else:
+        container = root.find(OFFICE_META) if is_odf else None
+        if container is None:
+            container = root
+        ET.SubElement(container, DC + 'title').text = title
+    return ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
+
+
+def make_title_copy(src, dst, ext, title):
+    # Write a copy of the input whose title metadata equals `title`.
+    if ext == '.rtf':
+        with open(src, 'rb') as fh:
+            text = fh.read().decode('latin-1')
+        s = text.find('{' + BS + 'title')
+        if s >= 0 and group_end(text, s) >= 0:
+            text = text[:s] + text[group_end(text, s) + 1:]
+        new = '{' + BS + 'title ' + rtf_escape(title) + '}'
+        if '{' + BS + 'info' in text:
+            text = text.replace('{' + BS + 'info', '{' + BS + 'info' + new, 1)
+        else:
+            text = text.replace(BS + 'rtf1', BS + 'rtf1{' + BS + 'info' + new + '}', 1)
+        with open(dst, 'wb') as fh:
+            fh.write(text.encode('latin-1'))
+        return
+    part = SUPPORTED[ext][2]
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(dst, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
+        for info in zin.infolist():
+            data = zin.read(info.filename)
+            if info.filename == part:
+                data = patch_core_xml(data, title, ext == '.odt')
+            zout.writestr(info, data)
+
+
+def validate(path, ext):
+    if ext == '.rtf':
+        with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
+            head = fh.read(5)
+        if head != b'{' + BS.encode() + b'rtf':
+            fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'not an RTF file')
+        return
+    main_part = SUPPORTED[ext][0]
+    try:
+        if not zipfile.is_zipfile(path):
+            fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'not a valid %s package' % ext)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
+            if zf.testzip() is not None or main_part not in zf.namelist():
+                fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'corrupt or incomplete %s package' % ext)
+            ET.fromstring(zf.read(main_part))
+    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, ET.ParseError, ValueError) as exc:
+        fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'unreadable %s input: %s' % (ext, exc))
+
+
+def kill_group(proc):
+    try:
+        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+
+def run_soffice(in_file, work, ext):
+    soffice = shutil.which('soffice') or '/usr/bin/soffice'
+    if not os.path.exists(soffice):
+        fail(EXIT_ERROR, 'LibreOffice (soffice) not found')
+    profile = os.path.join(work, 'profile')
+    cmd = [
+        soffice,
+        '-env:UserInstallation=file://' + profile,
+        '--headless',
+        '--norestore',
+        '--nolockcheck',
+        '--nodefault',
+        '--nologo',
+        '--convert-to', 'pdf:%s:%s' % (SUPPORTED[ext][1], PDF_OPTIONS),
+        '--outdir', work,
+        in_file,
+    ]
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env['HOME'] = work
+    env['LANG'] = 'C.UTF-8'
+    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=work, env=env, start_new_session=True)
+    try:
+        _, err = proc.communicate(timeout=CONVERSION_TIMEOUT)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        kill_group(proc)
+        proc.communicate()
+        fail(EXIT_TIMEOUT, 'conversion timed out after %s s' % CONVERSION_TIMEOUT)
+    kill_group(proc)
+    return err
+
+
+def convert(src, ext, stem, outdir):
+    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='office2pdf-')
+    try:
+        try:
+            title = read_title(src, ext)
+        except Exception:
+            title = None
+        title = title or stem
+        in_file = os.path.join(work, 'input' + ext)
+        make_title_copy(src, in_file, ext, title)
+        err = run_soffice(in_file, work, ext)
+        pdf = os.path.join(work, 'input.pdf')
+        head = b''
+        if os.path.isfile(pdf):
+            with open(pdf, 'rb') as fh:
+                head = fh.read(5)
+        if head != b'%PDF-':
+            fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'conversion failed: ' + err.decode('utf-8', 'replace')[-500:])
+        final = os.path.join(outdir, stem + '.pdf')
+        shutil.copyfile(pdf, final)
+        return os.path.abspath(final)
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def main(argv):
+    if len(argv) != 3:
+        fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'usage: convert.py <input> <outdir>')
+    src, outdir = argv[1], argv[2]
+    stem, ext = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(src))
+    ext = ext.lower()
+    if ext not in SUPPORTED or not stem:
+        fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'unsupported extension: %r' % ext)
+    if not os.path.isfile(src) or not os.access(src, os.R_OK):
+        fail(EXIT_UNREADABLE, 'input is not a readable file: %s' % src)
+    if os.path.getsize(src) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
+        fail(EXIT_TOO_LARGE, 'input exceeds 25 MB')
+    validate(src, ext)
+    try:
+        os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        fail(EXIT_ERROR, 'cannot create output directory: %s' % exc)
+    path = convert(src, ext, stem, outdir)
+    sys.stdout.write(path + '\n')
+    sys.stdout.flush()
+    return EXIT_OK
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

+# Builds small sample office documents with the standard library only.
+import zipfile
+from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
+
+B = chr(92)
+HDR = "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8' standalone='yes'?>"
+REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/'
+OFFICE_DOC_REL = REL + 'officeDocument'
+CORE_REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/core-properties'
+ODF_NS = 'urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:office:1.0'
+CORE_CT = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml'
+DOCX_MAIN = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml'
+PPTX_MAIN = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation.main+xml'
+XLSX_MAIN = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml'
+WS_MAIN = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml'
+SLIDE_MASTER = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideMaster+xml'
+SLIDE_LAYOUT = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slideLayout+xml'
+SLIDE = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml'
+NS_P = ("xmlns:a='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main' "
+        "xmlns:r='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships' "
+        "xmlns:p='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'")
+
+
+def _zip(path, parts, stored=None):
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
+        if stored:
+            zf.writestr(stored[0], stored[1], compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED)
+        for name, data in parts:
+            zf.writestr(name, data)
+
+
+def _rels(items):
+    body = ''.join("<Relationship Id='%s' Type='%s' Target='%s'/>" % item for item in items)
+    return HDR + "<Relationships xmlns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'>" + body + '</Relationships>'
+
+
+def _ct(overrides):
+    base = ("<Default Extension='rels' ContentType='application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml'/>"
+            "<Default Extension='xml' ContentType='application/xml'/>")
+    items = ''.join("<Override PartName='%s' ContentType='%s'/>" % o for o in overrides)
+    return HDR + "<Types xmlns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types'>" + base + items + '</Types>'
+
+
+def _core(title):
+    t = '' if title is None else '<dc:title>%s</dc:title>' % escape(title)
+    return (HDR + "<cp:coreProperties xmlns:cp='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties' "
+            "xmlns:dc='http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/'>" + t + '</cp:coreProperties>')
+
+
+def _ooxml(path, main_target, main_type, extra_overrides, parts, title):
+    overrides = [('/' + main_target, main_type), ('/docProps/core.xml', CORE_CT)] + extra_overrides
+    all_parts = ([('[Content_Types].xml', _ct(overrides)),
+                  ('_rels/.rels', _rels([('rId1', OFFICE_DOC_REL, main_target),
+                                         ('rId2', CORE_REL, 'docProps/core.xml')]))]
+                 + parts + [('docProps/core.xml', _core(title))])
+    _zip(path, all_parts)
+
+
+def make_docx(path, text, title=None):
+    body = ("<w:document xmlns:w='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'>"
+            '<w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>%s</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:body></w:document>') % escape(text)
+    _ooxml(path, 'word/document.xml', DOCX_MAIN, [], [('word/document.xml', HDR + body)], title)
+
+
+def make_pptx(path, text, title=None):
+    sp_tree = ('<p:cSld><p:spTree><p:nvGrpSpPr><p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/><p:cNvGrpSpPr/><p:nvPr/></p:nvGrpSpPr>'
+               '<p:grpSpPr/>%s</p:spTree></p:cSld>')
+    textbox = ('<p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="2" name="Text"/><p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/><p:nvPr/></p:nvSpPr>'
+               '<p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="640080" y="640080"/><a:ext cx="7000000" cy="1000000"/></a:xfrm>'
+               '<a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom></p:spPr><p:txBody><a:bodyPr/><a:lstStyle/>'
+               '<a:p><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US"/><a:t>%s</a:t></a:r></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp>') % escape(text)
+    pres = (HDR + '<p:presentation ' + NS_P + '><p:sldMasterIdLst><p:sldMasterId id="2147483648" r:id="rId1"/>'
+            '</p:sldMasterIdLst><p:sldIdLst><p:sldId id="256" r:id="rId2"/></p:sldIdLst>'
+            '<p:sldSz cx="9144000" cy="6858000"/><p:notesSz cx="6858000" cy="9144000"/></p:presentation>')
+    master = (HDR + '<p:sldMaster ' + NS_P + '>' + (sp_tree % '') +
+              '<p:clrMap bg1="lt1" tx1="dk1" bg2="lt2" tx2="dk2" accent1="accent1" accent2="accent2" '
+              'accent3="accent3" accent4="accent4" accent5="accent5" accent6="accent6" hlink="hlink" '
+              'folHlink="folHlink"/><p:sldLayoutIdLst><p:sldLayoutId id="2147483649" r:id="rId1"/>'
+              '</p:sldLayoutIdLst></p:sldMaster>')
+    layout = (HDR + '<p:sldLayout ' + NS_P + ' type="blank" preserve="1">' + (sp_tree % '') +
+              '<p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sldLayout>')
+    slide = (HDR + '<p:sld ' + NS_P + '>' + (sp_tree % textbox) +
+             '<p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>')
+    parts = [
+        ('ppt/presentation.xml', pres),
+        ('ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels', _rels([('rId1', REL + 'slideMaster', 'slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml'),
+                                                   ('rId2', REL + 'slide', 'slides/slide1.xml')])),
+        ('ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml', master),
+        ('ppt/slideMasters/_rels/slideMaster1.xml.rels', _rels([('rId1', REL + 'slideLayout', '../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml')])),
+        ('ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml', layout),
+        ('ppt/slideLayouts/_rels/slideLayout1.xml.rels', _rels([('rId1', REL + 'slideMaster', '../slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml')])),
+        ('ppt/slides/slide1.xml', slide),
+        ('ppt/slides/_rels/slide1.xml.rels', _rels([('rId1', REL + 'slideLayout', '../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml')])),
+    ]
+    extra = [('/ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml', SLIDE_MASTER),
+             ('/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml', SLIDE_LAYOUT),
+             ('/ppt/slides/slide1.xml', SLIDE)]
+    _ooxml(path, 'ppt/presentation.xml', PPTX_MAIN, extra, parts, title)
+
+
+def make_xlsx(path, text, title=None):
+    def sheet(value):
+        return (HDR + "<worksheet xmlns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'>"
+                "<sheetData><row r='1'><c r='A1' t='inlineStr'><is><t>%s</t></is></c></row></sheetData></worksheet>") % escape(value)
+    wb = (HDR + "<workbook xmlns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main' "
+          "xmlns:r='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'><sheets>"
+          "<sheet name='Alpha' sheetId='1' r:id='rId1'/><sheet name='Beta' sheetId='2' r:id='rId2'/>"
+          '</sheets></workbook>')
+    wb_rels = _rels([('rId1', REL + 'worksheet', 'worksheets/sheet1.xml'),
+                     ('rId2', REL + 'worksheet', 'worksheets/sheet2.xml')])
+    extra = [('/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', WS_MAIN), ('/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml', WS_MAIN)]
+    parts = [('xl/workbook.xml', wb), ('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', wb_rels),
+             ('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', sheet(text)),
+             ('xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml', sheet(text + ' beta'))]
+    _ooxml(path, 'xl/workbook.xml', XLSX_MAIN, extra, parts, title)
+
+
+def make_odt(path, text, title=None):
+    content = (HDR + "<office:document-content xmlns:office='%s' "
+               "xmlns:text='urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:text:1.0' office:version='1.2'>"
+               '<office:body><office:text><text:p>%s</text:p></office:text></office:body>'
+               '</office:document-content>') % (ODF_NS, escape(text))
+    t = '' if title is None else '<dc:title>%s</dc:title>' % escape(title)
+    meta = (HDR + "<office:document-meta xmlns:office='%s' xmlns:dc='http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/' "
+            "office:version='1.2'><office:meta>%s</office:meta></office:document-meta>") % (ODF_NS, t)
+    styles = HDR + "<office:document-styles xmlns:office='%s' office:version='1.2'/>" % ODF_NS
+    manifest = (HDR + "<manifest:manifest xmlns:manifest='urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:manifest:1.0' "
+                "manifest:version='1.2'>"
+                "<manifest:file-entry manifest:full-path='/' manifest:media-type='application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text'/>"
+                "<manifest:file-entry manifest:full-path='content.xml' manifest:media-type='text/xml'/>"
+                "<manifest:file-entry manifest:full-path='styles.xml' manifest:media-type='text/xml'/>"
+                "<manifest:file-entry manifest:full-path='meta.xml' manifest:media-type='text/xml'/>"
+                '</manifest:manifest>')
+    _zip(path, [('content.xml', content), ('meta.xml', meta), ('styles.xml', styles),
+                ('META-INF/manifest.xml', manifest)],
+         stored=('mimetype', 'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text'))
+
+
+def make_rtf(path, text, title=None):
+    info = '' if title is None else '{' + B + 'info{' + B + 'title ' + title + '}}'
+    body = ('{' + B + 'rtf1' + B + 'ansi' + B + 'deff0 {' + B + 'fonttbl {' + B + 'f0 Times;}}' + info +
+            B + 'f0 ' + text + B + 'par }')

+

+                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, cwd=cwd, env=env)
+
+
+def one_error_line(proc):
+    lines = proc.stderr.strip().splitlines()
+    return len(lines) == 1 and lines[0].startswith('convert.py: ')
+
+
+def test_oversized_input_rejected(tmp_path):
+    big = tmp_path / 'big.docx'
+    remaining = 30 * 1024 * 1024
+    with open(big, 'wb') as fh:
+        while remaining > 0:
+            chunk = os.urandom(min(remaining, 1024 * 1024))
+            fh.write(chunk)
+            remaining -= len(chunk)
+    out = tmp_path / 'out'
+    proc = run([big, out])
+    assert proc.returncode == 3, proc.stderr
+    assert 'Traceback' not in proc.stderr
+    assert one_error_line(proc), proc.stderr
+    assert 'MB' in proc.stderr

+
+

+    trunc.write_bytes(data[:len(data) // 2])
+    proc = run([trunc, tmp_path / 'out2'])
+    assert proc.returncode == 2, proc.stderr
+    assert 'Traceback' not in proc.stderr
+    assert one_error_line(proc), proc.stderr
+
+

+    bindir = tmp_path / 'bin'
+    bindir.mkdir()
